title: Right hand and fingers
goal: Sit well, learn the finger numbers and play five notes with your right hand.

steps.title: How to sit
steps.text: Sit tall with your arms relaxed and your elbows a little above the keys. Let your right hand rest on the keys with curved fingers, as if holding a ball.

steps.title: Finger numbers
steps.text: Each finger has a number: thumb 1, pointer 2, middle 3, ring 4, little finger 5. The numbers show on the lit keys.

steps.title: Thumb on middle C
steps.text: Put your right thumb (1) on middle C. Your other fingers rest on the next white keys: D E F G. Five fingers, five keys.

steps.title: Thumb check
steps.prompt: Press middle C with your thumb

steps.title: Up with five fingers
steps.text: Play C D E F G, one finger for each key.

steps.title: Back down
steps.text: Now G F E D C, finger 5 down to finger 1.

steps.title: Up and down
steps.text: Put them together, up and then down.

steps.title: Once more, no lights
steps.text: The keys will not light up this time. Remember where your fingers go.
